primaryBoundaries.vector: complete semantic retrieval including pinned-model inference and authorized SQLite reads
primaryBoundaries.parser: cold polyglot indexing and whole worker request including serialization and persistence
primaryBoundaries.topology: each CLI analysis operation including snapshot loading and output projection; more than 100000 nodes

contract.refresh: refresh after separately owned crypto lands; identical configuration apart from candidate change

identities.sampler: existing external recursive process-tree sampler (effective interval in telemetry); parent RSS interval2ms; parent process.cpuUsage request delta

sql-row-transport.boundary: Actual request SQLite span UNION: SQL compilation/acquisition/native execution and row construction

validation-scoring-top-k.boundary: Observed reader envelope minus UNION of its SQLite intervals: validation/scoring/top-k plus reader/transaction/control residual, not pure math

limitations: Synthetic document embeddings; real-query mode verifies the pinned installed model without downloading it.
